article.title: Brazilian political drama unfolds as defeated Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
article.summary: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in the U.S. after Brazilian authorities ordered him to surrender his passport. He is facing multiple investigations in Brazil.
